items.name: DocenBox — Comprehensive Teacher Management Suite
items.description: Comprehensive web platform designed to eliminate administrative overload for teachers. Centralizes real-time attendance tracking, gradebooks with automated averaging and remediation workflows, official curricular planning, and multi-school scheduling with conflict detection.
items.problemSolved: Multi-tenant UID data isolation using Cloud Firestore with offline support. Zero accidental data loss via Soft Delete trash system and automated recurring billing.

items.name: Config & URL Security Inspector — Local .env & Endpoints Auditor
items.description: Zero-Trust static offline security auditor for configuration files (.env) and endpoint inspector (CSP connect-src 'none'). Detects high-risk secret signatures (JWT, Stripe, Cloud keys, DB connection strings), computes Shannon entropy, generates sanitized .env.example templates, and audits sensitive URL query leaks and critical ports without network traffic.
items.problemSolved: 100% deterministic processing in volatile RAM with zero localStorage persistence. Local SHA-256 cryptographic digest and 256-bit CSPRNG via Web Crypto API with Node.js unit tests.
